summary: A drone synth firmware with two always-on drones that you tune, shape and move instead of playing notes, inspired by the Stylophone DS-2, Subharmonicon and Lyra-8.
features: Each drone: morphing oscillator, partner, sub or subharmonic, noise, filter
Pitch link, hard sync and cross-modulation between the two drones
Eight gestures on the keys, held or pressure-driven; 16 presets and 48 scenes
Two-wave LFO, rhythmic Swell, Drift and Wander keep it moving on its own
Six delay types, drive, five reverbs up to infinite; motion loop recorder
MIDI notes tune the drones; locks Swell, LFO and delay to MIDI clock
